name: jsip
description: A document-driven project workflow that preserves intent from brainstorming through implementation.

interface.longDescription: JSIP guides one initiative through explicit brainstorming, planning, and test-first implementation stages. Versioned artifacts, approval gates, and traceable evidence keep implementation aligned with approved intent.
defaultPrompt: Use JSIP to turn this idea into an approved specification.
Create an implementation plan from my approved JSIP spec.
Implement my approved JSIP plan without drifting from intent.
